posts.hook: AI safety just won real elections
posts.caption: an anthropic-backed super pac spent $63m and won 10 of 17 races, a coding agent permission option is tied to passwords in public repos, the us moves to cut mexc off from its financial system. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: An Anthropic-backed super PAC spent ==$63M== and won 10 of 17 races
slides.desc: Stricter-oversight candidates now have a proven funding model heading into AI legislation.

terms.gloss: a group that can raise and spend unlimited money to back candidates

slides.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" option tied to passwords in 1,122 public files
slides.desc: A convenience setting that stops prompting also stops a human catching secrets before commit.

slides.title: The US Treasury moves to cut crypto exchange MEXC off from American finance
slides.desc: It alleges $16B+ in illicit flows, including Russian and Iranian sanctions evasion.

slides.title: Malaysia and Thailand paused 49 data center projects on power and water limits
slides.desc: Southeast Asia is about half of APAC capacity under construction.

posts.hook: The AI race is now a hunt for power plants and cash
posts.caption: anthropic bought commitments for 1.7gw of gas generators for $3.4b, openai raised $11b at a $1.25t valuation, apple reportedly wants an agentic siri. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic bought ==1.7GW== of gas generator commitments for $3.4B
slides.desc: FT sources say it is the largest known such buy by an AI lab, going around usual suppliers.

terms.gloss: a gigawatt: roughly the output of a large power plant

slides.title: OpenAI raised $11B at a $1.25T valuation, below the $1.4T it first sought
slides.desc: The round closed under the opening ask, a read on what investors pay for frontier labs.

slides.title: Nous says its Qwen tune cuts state-aligned framing from 22% to under 1%
slides.desc: If it holds, a cheap tune can reshape a model's politics. Nous's own numbers so far.

slides.title: Apple's new CEO reportedly presses for an agentic Siri, possibly next year
slides.desc: Apple is signaling it will chase assistants that act, not just answer.

slides.title: Elvis and Eminem rights holders sue Suno over mimicked music
slides.desc: Allegations only. The Presley suit invokes Tennessee's ELVIS Act on voice cloning.

terms.gloss: a Tennessee law against cloning a singer's voice with AI

slides.title: Inner Mongolia built 120MW of an 800MW wind campus within a year
slides.desc: SemiAnalysis says it is China's fastest-growing AI data center region, with no public backlash.
